t: What Storage Reliability Database Is All About
title: What Storage Reliability Database Is All About
description: Storage reliability is AFR (annualized failure rate: Backblaze publishes HDD ~1-2%), TBW (terabytes written: SSD endurance), UBER (unrecoverable bit error rate), and MTBF. RAID (0/1/5/6/10) trades capacity for redundancy; backups (3-2-1 rule) for the rest. SSDs fail differently (wear-out, sudden) than HDDs (mechanical, SMART warnings). Monitor SMART; replace proactively. This database is the complete storage reliability record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
